text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm out shopping on my day off, when...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober comes bursting out from a
very
crowded store.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I failed again. I was so close to getting that fragrance oil too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's it to you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, um, I...
choice_data_list: Didn't you come here to buy something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Why do you care? It's nothing important
anyway,
so I'm going to call it a day and
go back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What's with you? In case you didn't hear
me the
first time, I'm done here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It looks like I won't be able to buy her a present after all... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, one of my relatives has been
really burnt
out lately. I thought getting
her some fragrance
oil would be a good
pick-me-up.
choice_data_list: Why not look for a different gift?
Steel your resolve and let's dive right in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But the store is packed today because
there's a
sale going on. I can't make any
headway at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I need to head back soon, though...
What should I
do...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What are you on about? "Get something
else?"
Who asked you?
choice_data_list: Why not look for a different gift?
Steel your resolve and let's dive right in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Get something else... I never
thought to do
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Come to think of it, she really loves
Mont
Blanc.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It's not as if I'm taking your
advice. I just
happened to remember
that about her...
Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What would cheer her up... She seemed
to love
the Mont Blanc I made for her
last time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That might just work! It's important to
try and
change perspective at times like
these.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the tip. I think I'll try to get
the
fragrance oil another time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What are you trying to say? That I'm not
taking
this seriously enough?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Plow on through? I wonder if that'll
work. I could
barely take a step as it
was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, but I really don't want to give
up. I want
to do something to make my
relative feel better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to try again, and this time, I'll
stand my
ground! Thanks for the
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to let that snide comment
slide... I'll
bulldoze right through them,
just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, she  heads straight back into
the
crowded store.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober emerges triumphantly with
the
fragrance oil in hand. I hear her
murmur, "I hope
McQueen likes this,"
before hurrying away.
